description: December 23 birthday meaning: Sagittarius or Capricorn cusp, birthday number 5, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, December 23 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn. In numerology the day gives birthday number 5, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The December 23 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Late December's festive bustle suits the 23rd. Depending on birth year and time, the Sun is in the final degree of Sagittarius or the first degrees of Capricorn; in most years it is Capricorn, in the Saturn-ruled first decan. Twenty-three reduces to 5, so the blend mixes discipline with curiosity: a practical planner who still loves surprises.

Astronomically, December 23 puts the Sun near 1° Capricorn in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Saturn. Birthdays around December 20 to December 22 fall on the Sagittarius–Capricorn cusp, near the December solstice. Mutable fire meets cardinal earth, and optimism meets ambition. Which sign the Sun was actually in depends on the year, time and birthplace, as the moment of ingress varies; a chart for your exact details is the way to confirm it. Those who carry both energies are often described as visionaries with a plan, people who dream large and then build methodically. They may swing between restlessness and serious focus, and both modes tend to serve them.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for December 23
paragraphs: Born on the 23rd, you have a compound of 2 + 3 = 5. The 2 brings sensitivity and the 3 brings expression, and the 5 that results is curious, social and quick on its feet. People born on the 23rd are often described as excellent communicators with a gift for reading people and a strong appetite for new experiences. Travel, languages and varied work tend to appeal. Among the day numbers, the 23 is traditionally seen as one of the most adaptable. Commitment can feel restrictive, so choosing carefully what to say yes to helps them keep their freedom meaningful.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a December 23 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous December 23 birthdays
paragraphs: December birthdays arrive at the start of northern winter, around the shortest days and the year's festivities, and at the start of summer in the southern hemisphere. Sagittarius holds most of the month, with Capricorn beginning around December 21 or 22. In numerology December is month 12, which reduces to 3: expression and sociability, built from the 1 and 2 of initiative and partnership. December 23 is the 357th day of the year (358th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aquarius, is usually complete within 29 days, by January 21.

By December 23 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a December 23 birthday are Akihito (1933), Alexander I of Russia (1777) and Helmut Schmidt (1918).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is December 23?
faq.answer: December 23 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Sagittarius or Capricorn on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Capricorn. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on December 23?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On December 23 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 5 for everyone born on the 23rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on December 23?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by December 23, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on December 23?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on December 23 include Akihito (1933), Alexander I of Russia (1777) and Helmut Schmidt (1918). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
